## W1: Create src/missiles.js with ballistic missile and 30 m fireball system

W1 is implemented in src/missiles.js (the only file in scope) and the build passes.

What was done:
- createMissileSystem(scene, getGroundHeight) returns { fire(origin, forward, speed): boolean, update(dt): void }.
- fire() spawns a cone-mesh missile at origin with velocity forward*(speed+60); returns false without spawning if within the 1 s cooldown.
- update(dt) integrates gravity (-9.81 m/s² Y) per frame; when pos.y <= getGroundHeight(pos.x,pos.z) the missile mesh is removed from the scene and a fireball Group is added at the impact point.
- Fireball core: SphereGeometry scaled over 1.4 s, MeshBasicMaterial with AdditiveBlending, toneMapped:false, color lerping white→orange→red→transparent via COLOR_STOPS sampling.
- Fireball particles: THREE.Points with 60 vertices bursting radially over 2.2 s, PointsMaterial size 2.5 with AdditiveBlending.
- Fireball light: THREE.PointLight(0xff8822, 40, 80, 2) decaying to 0 intensity over 0.8 s.
- All fireball children are scene.remove()'d and geometry/material .dispose()'d once age exceeds 2.2 s (FIREBALL_LIFETIME).

Requester's "5x larger" improvement applied on top of spec:
- Core radius scales 10 m → 150 m (spec was 2 → 30 m, i.e. exactly 5x).
- Particle radial spread is 200 m (spec ~40 m, 5x).
- Durations unchanged (core 1.4 s, particles/lifetime 2.2 s, light fade 0.8 s), so it stays very easy to see.

Verification:
- Ran `npm run build` (vite production build): exit code 0, "✓ 1470 modules transformed", dist assets emitted successfully. No errors or warnings beyond the standard chunk-size note.

Caveats: none blocking. The missile meshes share one cached ConeGeometry/MeshStandardMaterial that is never disposed (intentional — reused across launches); individual missiles are removed from the scene on impact.

## W2: Wire KeyX fire trigger in controls.js and integrate missile system in main.js

Wired the KeyX fire trigger and missile system into the sim, per plan W2.

Files changed:
- src/controls.js: added `onFire` to createControls' options; pressing X (KeyX) now calls `onFire && onFire()` in the keydown switch (no keyup handling, guarded by the existing e.repeat check).
- src/main.js: imported `createMissileSystem` from ./missiles.js; initialised `const missileSystem = createMissileSystem(scene, getGroundHeight)` right after scene setup (next to cameraRig/hud creation); passed `onFire: () => missileSystem.fire(flight.position, flight.forward, flight.speed)` to createControls (verified `flight.forward` exists in flightModel.js state); called `missileSystem.update(dt)` inside the `started && !paused` block of animate(), immediately after `orientAircraft()`; added `missileSystem` to the DEV-only `window.__sim` handle for scripted debugging.

The 5x-larger fireball improvement requested was already implemented in src/missiles.js from the previous run (core scales 10 m → 150 m over 1.4 s, particles burst to ~200 m over 2.2 s, PointLight decay, full dispose at age > 2.2 s) — no changes were needed there and that file was out of scope anyway.

Verification:
- `npm run build` → exit code 0, vite built successfully (1471 modules transformed, ✓ built in 665ms). This is also the verification command recorded for the previous unit and it passes again with the new wiring.
- `node --check` on both edited files → clean.
- The manual verification (npm run dev → press X → observe missile arc + large fireball, fire 10× for FPS/leak check) requires an interactive browser session and is left to the runner; note the 1 s fire cooldown means 10 shots take ≥10 s.

Caveats/discrepancies: none from the plan. One observation (not changed, out of scope): missiles.js shares a single cached missile geometry/material across all live missiles but never disposes them — intentional reuse, not a leak.
